title: Senior Account Director, Blavity Media Group
description:

We are always searching for new additions to our community that will help us continue to scale, contribute meaningfully to our culture, and advance our strategic direction.

Job Summary:

title: Patient Care Coordinator - B075 (SR)
description:
Work From Anywhere in LATAM or the Philippines
Work Schedule: CST │ 9:00 AM - 5:00 PM (Monday-Friday)
About Pearl Talent

Pearl works with the top 1% of candidates from around the world and connects them with the best startups in the US and EU. Our clients have raised over $5B in aggregate and are backed by companies like OpenAI, a16z, and Founders Fund.
Hear why we exist, what we believe in, and who we're building for:
Watch here:
About the Client
An early-stage AI healthtech company is building a clinical co-pilot platform for urgent care practices across the US, and is hiring a Patient Referral Coordinator to take on the human side of its patient referral outreach.
The company's platform flags care gaps in real time and is scaling quickly across its network of urgent care clinics - this is the company's first hire dedicated to this function, with referral outreach currently handled directly by the founding team.
About the Role
As Patient Referral Coordinator, you'll call patients flagged by the platform for specialist follow-up, explain in plain language why the referral matters, address questions or hesitations, and help them book their next appointment - either directly or via follow-up text, email, or voicemail. The role starts light and is expected to scale over the coming months as referral volume grows; success is measured by booking conversion rate and how quickly you respond to new referral notifications.
Core Responsibilities
Patient Outreach & Booking

• Call referral-eligible patients flagged by the platform, starting at approximately 5 patients per day and scaling over time

• Explain in plain language why a specialist referral is needed based on the patient's care gap

• Address patient objections and questions with empathy, guiding them toward booking without pressure

• Book appointments directly through the internal dashboard or coordinate with the patient's preferred provider

• Maintain a booking conversion rate of 80%+ across all eligible patients contacted

Follow-Up & Patient Communication

• Leave voicemails and send text/email follow-ups for patients who don't answer on the first attempt

• Re-contact patients from previous days who have not yet booked

• Research and answer patient questions about insurance, logistics, or referral reasoning

• Escalate clinical questions outside scope to the appropriate internal contact

Dashboard & Compliance

• Review overnight patient notifications each morning via the internal dashboard

• Update patient status (booked, no answer, declined, follow-up needed) using the platform's workflow tools

• Access and review medical record summaries to understand patient context before calling

• Handle Protected Health Information (PHI) in accordance with HIPAA and company data protocols

• Maintain accurate documentation of all patient interactions

Requirements
Requirements
Must-Have

• 2+ years of experience in patient-facing healthcare coordination, medical customer service, or healthcare BPO roles involving outbound phone communication

• Demonstrated experience with objection-handling or conversion-focused communication (e.g., appointment-setting, booking rate metrics, or persuasion-based customer service)

• Experience working directly with US-based patients, clients, or customers by phone

• C2 CEFR English fluency (near-native, unobstructive accent for US patient-facing calls)

• Experience navigating CRM, scheduling, or patient management dashboards

• Demonstrated ability to work independently with minimal supervision (e.g., small-team, startup, or remote BPO environment)

• Availability to work 9:00 AM-5:00 PM Central Time

Nice-to-Have

• Spanish-English bilingual fluency (B2+ CEFR Spanish)

• Familiarity with medical terminology, ICD diagnosis codes, or insurance verification processes

• Prior HIPAA or PHI handling training

• Experience in an early-stage startup or fast-scaling, low-structure environment

Benefits

•
Competitive Salary: Based on experience

• بعد التسجيل، الإجابة عن بعض الأسئلة القصيرة عن نفسك، مثل الفئة العمرية، والدولة، واللهجة، لمساعدتنا في تنظيم مجموعة البيانات.

متطلبات التسجيل
يجب استيفاء جميع المتطلبات التالية حتى يتم قبول الفيديو:

•
جودة الفيديو: 1080p أو أعلى.

•
المدة: من 15 إلى 20 ثانية.

•
التصوير: يجب أن يظهر الرأس والكتفان، وأن يكون الوجه في منتصف الصورة وواضحًا بالكامل.

•
الإضاءة والخلفية: يجب أن يكون الوجه مضاءً جيدًا ومن دون ظلال قوية، مع خلفية بسيطة أو محايدة.

•

•
الصوت: واضح ومن دون ضوضاء في الخلفية أو موسيقى أو صدى.

•
اتجاه التصوير: يمكن التصوير بشكل رأسي أو أفقي، مع تثبيت الكاميرا وتجنب الاهتزاز.

•
مكان التسجيل: يُفضل التسجيل في مكان داخلي هادئ.

•
غير مسموح: استخدام الفلاتر أو أوضاع التجميل، النظارات الشمسية، القبعات أو أغطية الرأس التي تحجب الوجه، أغطية الوجه، سماعات الرأس أو سماعات الأذن، العلامات المائية، الملصقات، الإطارات، أو ظهور أشخاص آخرين أو حيوانات أليفة في الفيديو.

title: Meridial – Scientist – In Vivo Neuroscience
description:
About Meridial
 
Meridial is a Focused Research Organisation (FRO) with a mission to bring connectomics into the living brain. We are building a platform for longitudinal, synapse-resolution mapping of functional neural circuitry in preclinical models. Our aim is to deploy this platform for translational projects and improve drug development outcomes for disorders of the central nervous system. 
 
Meridial is a new not-for-profit FRO in the Convergent Research Ecosystem and funded by the Advanced Research and Invention Agency (ARIA).
 
About the role
 
Meridial is seeking a Scientist - In Vivo Neuroscience to play a central role in establishing and running our in vivo experiments.
 
This is a hands-on scientific role focused on the development and execution of advanced in vivo neuroscience experiments. You will perform complex neurosurgery, longitudinal two-photon imaging and optogenetic experiments in mice, and develop new approaches as part of Meridial’s programme to create advanced 3D imaging and photostimulation technologies for functional mapping of neural circuits. We are looking for an exceptional experimentalist who combines substantial practical expertise with scientific independence. We would also welcome candidates who combine these experimental skills with substantial expertise in neural data analysis.
 
You will report to the Director of Experimental Research and work closely with them to build the lab. You will play a central role in establishing our core surgical, imaging and optogenetic protocols and the quality standards that underpin them. As the team grows over the coming year, you will train and mentor other scientists, guide their day-to-day experimental work and help shape how the team works together. You will also work closely with engineers and computational researchers across Meridial.

You’ll build systems that give defenders an advantage at a scale few engineering teams encounter. Alongside OpenAI’s account teams, you’ll translate security priorities into deployed systems that help defenders cover more ground.

You’ll also help shape what OpenAI builds next. When you identify a gap between what defenders need and what today’s models or products can do, you’ll partner with Research and Product to define, build, and test capabilities that address it.

title: Director, Regulatory Affairs
description:
State regulators and departments of insurance, industry advocacy groups and more are actively deciding how aerial imagery and AI can be used in underwriting and rating. More than a dozen departments of insurance have issued bulletins on the subject, with imagery recency limits running from 180 days to two years, constraints on what evidence supports an adverse action, and new disclosure and appeal requirements for consumers. Legislation is moving in several more states, and a national model act is in draft. These rules determine how much of Nearmap 's value a carrier can realize, and in the most restrictive states they shape whether particular use cases are viable at all.
This role owns Nearmap 's answer. You will build and lead our insurance regulatory affairs function, setting our regulatory strategy, engaging with regulators and legislators to help inform and understand the latest changes, and advising insurance customers on best practices for using Nearmap AI products in admitted markets. You will track every bulletin and bill that touches imagery and AI, and you will publish the positions our customers and our field can rely on.
The framework for imagery and AI for the insurance industry is still being written, and you will put Nearmap in the room, arguing standards that reflect what current imagery and AI can support.
You will be starting from a solid foundation. Nearmap data is approved in more than fifty rate filings, and we maintain a working database of state bulletins and legislation. What we do not have is a single owner. This is a builder role with immediate impact: you will step into active filing engagements from week one, and you will build the function behind them, which includes the state playbooks and the positions Nearmap stands behind.
You will report into Insurance Product, which puts you close to where new attributes and scores are designed, and you will work daily with data science, actuarial, Legal, and our customer-facing teams.
You'll be the regulatory face of Nearmap :

• Act as the named Nearmap contact across the filing lifecycle, from pre-filing consultation through objection response and post-approval maintenance.

• Own Nearmap regulatory strategy, which includes where we will register, where and what we will file, and how. You’ll partner with insurance carriers to jointly design regulatory approaches that suit their needs.

• Lead objection response strategy, drawing analytical inputs from our actuarial and data science teams.

• Own our advisory organization relationship and the subscriber mechanics that sit between us and our carrier customers, and establish where those requirements are regulatory and where they are commercial.

• Develop a recommendation on advisory organization registration beyond our existing Arizona registration and own this strategy on an ongoing basis as the regulatory landscape continues to evolve.

• Partner with Legal on the privilege, contractual, and compliance questions that arise from filings and regulator engagement.

You'll own the filing program:

• Own Nearmap rate filing approach end-to-end to support carrier filing programs: scoping, materials, submission coordination, tracking, objection response, and close.

• Coordinate on and collaborate with cross functional teams to support a rate filing materials library, including model memos, validation summaries, and methodology documentation, for every Nearmap attribute and score used in rating.

• Maintain state-by-state command of filing requirements, permissible confidentiality treatment, and filer eligibility.

• Manage version control and re-filing triggered by model updates, new attributes, validation findings, or regulator feedback.

• Monitor regulatory filings across all states and maintain up-to-date database of rating plans that use aerially derived data.

You'll help shape the rules, not just follow them:

title: Senior Executive Assistant to the Founder
description:
Hey! Alex here, founder of Elavate . I'm writing this one myself because you'll be working directly with me.

• Salary: £80,000+ base

• Location: Remote-first (we do have a London Office where some of our team work from)

• Reports to: Me, directly

• Hours: Full-time, but not a 9-to-5. Read "The hours" below before you apply

Who we are
We're the fastest-growing DTC brand in the UK. We sell a collagen supplement for women in their 40s, 50s and beyond.
We've grown to over £100M in annual revenue, completely bootstrapped. Now we're looking to keep taking over the UK collagen market and grow into the USA.
We have a warm, friendly culture. We're fast-growing and ambitious, and as we grow we need more smart people. You'll work with other smart people on meaningful, exciting work every day.
About the role
As Elavate keeps growing, there's loads coming up, so I'm looking for one sharp person to be my right hand. Someone I can hand anything to: my inbox, my Slack, the threads I haven't got to and the random projects that land on my desk.
Over time you become a version of me for everything outside creative, so I can spend my time on growth and the future direction of the company, our creative team and our rapid US expansion. Right now I spend around 6 hours a day clearing Slack and email before I get to the real work. Your job is to give me most of that back.
This isn't a diary-and-travel EA role. I barely travel and there isn't much personal admin. It's the business: hundreds of messages a week, lots of open loops, and someone good enough to handle most of it the way I would.
What you'll own

• My inbox. Stay on top of it: four sweeps a day, replies in my voice that I don't need to check, drafts for the rest, and every thread closed out.

• Very fast Slack replies. This one's really important. Clear the chats that don't need me, reply in thread, and only bring me what actually needs me.

• A daily roundup waiting when I'm online at midday: what needs me today, what you're handling, and what you've closed.

• Follow-ups and chasing. Be very organised and diligent here. If I've said it, it's written down, tracked and chased with the right people until it's closed, including by email as me.

• Meetings and calls. Prep notes before, recorded, then a summary and actions the next day. You'll also sit in on our weekly creative review and on supplier and partner calls, and hold people to their timelines.

• People and hiring admin. Hiring admin with our recruiters, onboarding and offboarding, and people admin for our international team.

• Trackers. A contracts and renewals tracker, plus cost tracking for things like influencer spend and software subscriptions.

• Admin that just happens. Invoices paid fast, plus the bookings that keep things moving (team hotel nights, padel, Airbnbs for shoots, team gifts) without checking in with me.

• Side projects outside everyone's remit. The things I've spotted but don't have time for, that don't sit in anyone's normal job. You dig in, figure it out and close it.

• SOPs in Notion as you go, so nothing lives only in my/your head.

What success looks like after 3 months

• I don't open my inbox or the misc Slack threads. You've handled them in my tone and I didn't need to check.

• Nothing I mention gets dropped.

• Every meeting has prep before it and a summary after.

• Bookings and admin happen without me thinking about them.

• I've got most of those 6 hours a day back.

Who you are

• Very sharp. You read between the lines, get context fast and figure things out on your own. If I mention something once, it's handled.

• Technical and fluent in AI. You build your own custom workflows and automations (Claude Code, n8n or whatever does the job), and you pick up new tools really fast.

• Proactive and independent. You don't wait to be told. You ask what you need, then follow up with the right people, chase and close things out yourself.

• Calm, organised and diligent. You bring order to a busy found

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life - or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

The Engineering Academy is designed to accelerate your tech career at Vinted. This intensive, hands-on programme features training sessions led by our very own experts, who will mentor and guide you through our technology and ways of working.

You’ll be hired on a 6 months contract , with the opportunity to join Vinted permanently after completing the Academy and continue growing your career with the skills you’ve gained.

Who are we looking for?

The Vinted Engineering Academy is where we grow our tech talent in  Backend  Engineering. Whether you’re a student, recent graduate, self-taught coder, or something else, this is the place for you.

We’re looking for people with some coding skills and a passion for all things engineering - those who are just starting their careers in this area and are eager to learn, grow, and make an impact.

When?

Our Spring Engineering Academy begins on March 1, 2027 . You will be expected to be available full time (0.8 contract option for University students is possible).

title: Principal Research Scientist – Multimodal Reasoning & Embodied AI
description:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

🛠️ About our Labs Team

Wayve Labs develops the next generation of learning capabilities for embodied AI, using autonomous driving as a demanding real-world testbed. Within FORGE, our Language & Reasoning team explores how LLMs, VLMs and VLAs can connect world knowledge, grounded reasoning, memory and planning to physical action. We work across model architectures, training and post-training, with the goal of helping driving agents generalise to new environments, follow goals and constraints, and handle rare situations. The team collaborates across London and Sunnyvale, with opportunities to publish fundamental research.

🧠 Your day-to-day

You will set and lead an ambitious research agenda at the intersection of LLMs, VLMs, VLAs and embodied AI, asking how agents can use world knowledge, visual understanding, memory and reasoning to make better decisions in the physical world.

You will remain hands-on: developing new architectures and learning methods, training and evaluating large-scale models, and testing whether better reasoning leads to better behaviour in challenging driving scenarios.

As a Principal Research Scientist, you will guide the technical direction of the team, mentor researchers, build strong collaborations with Engineering, and turn original ideas into rigorous evidence, influential publications and capabilities that shape Wayve's next generation of AI.

🧩 What you’ll be working on:

- Advance multimodal foundation models: Research and develop LLMs, VLMs and VLAs that integrate visual understanding, language, reasoning and action for embodied decision-making.

- Develop reasoning and planning capabilities: Explore structured and latent reasoning, long-horizon planning, temporal understanding, memory, self-reflection and test-time computation for physically grounded agents.

- Push the boundaries of model training: Develop scalable training and post-training methods, including supervised fine-tuning, reinforcement learning, reward modelling, distillation and learning from human or AI-generated feedback.

- Build steerable and adaptable policies: Enable embodied agents to understand instructions, follow goals and preferences, reason about constraints and generalise to novel environments and situations.

- Explore agentic and hierarchical architectures: Investigate how deliberative reasoning, memory, external tools and fast reactive policies can work together, balancing intelligence, reliability and real-time constraints.

- Bridge reasoning and action: Develop approaches that turn semantic understanding and reasoning into meaningful improvements in physical-world behaviour, rather than treating language generation as an end in itself.

- Drive research from idea to evidence: Design rigorous experiments, build prototypes, establish challenging evaluations and demonstrate improvements in real-world capabilities.

- Shape the research direction: Work closely with researchers across foundation models, representation learning, world modelling and reinforcement learning. Contribute original ideas, mentor others and help define the next generation of embodied AI systems.

🙌 You should apply if:

- A strong research track record in deep learning, particularly in one or more of LLMs, VLMs, VLAs, multimodal foundation models or embodied AI.

- Deep technical understanding of modern foundation model architectures, transformer-based models, multimodal representation learning and generative modelling.

- Hands-on experience developing, training, fine-tuning or post-training large-scale models, with a solid understanding of the challenges involved.

Trusted by Woven by Toyota, AXA, UiPath, Zipline, and more. We're an ambitious team of 100+ working at the frontier of AI and have raised $60M in Series C funding from Wellington Management, CRV, Next47 and Y Combinator.

You will lead the planning and execution of efforts needed as we grow from our customer base from hundreds to thousands of AI teams worldwide, and the volume of AI training and supervision data managed by our platform from TBs to PBs of data.
